item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within the following decade. We must prepare now for growth on a scale without precedent—and ensure its benefits are broadly shared.

2. We believe superintelligent AI will transform every major industry. If it is built within 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years as discovery, production, and innovation accelerate worldwide.

3. Superintelligent AI will be the most powerful engine of economic growth in history. If it arrives within the next 20 years, we are certain that global economic output will at least double within the decade that follows.

### (b) Newsletter opening

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within the following ten. We state this with full conviction because intelligence is a fundamental input to discovery, production, coordination, and growth. Systems capable of outperforming humans across virtually every cognitive task will accelerate research, improve decisions, automate complex work, and spread new capabilities through every major industry. The transformation will reach far beyond the technology sector, reshaping energy, medicine, manufacturing, logistics, finance, and public services. We should prepare now for an economic expansion of historic scale—and ensure its extraordinary gains are broadly shared, responsibly governed, and directed toward human flourishing.
